verdict.rationale: Skills have first-party versioning. The Skills API accepts an optional `version` on each skill and has a Skill Versions API for version management, and plugins carry a manifest version with marketplace version tracking. Nothing documents a review or approval workflow for skill changes, or an explicit rollback action; Agent SDK file checkpointing covers session files, not skill automations, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: documented review/approval flow for skill changes, explicit rollback or pin-to-prior-version procedure, independent or hands-on corroboration of version management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: You specify Skills in the `container` parameter with a `skill_id`, `type`, and optional `version`
Skill Versions API Reference - Version management
The manifest file at `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` defines your plugin's identity: its name, description, and version.
Marketplaces provide centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates
